scope: Original Weird CUA Bench implementation of the Velvet Valet parking mechanic.
policy: The cited source seeds the nonholonomic parking mechanic only. All shipped presentation, procedural geometry, vehicle integration, browser interaction, grading, and verification are original code; no third-party media is redistributed.

velvet_valet.influence: Continuous steering and throttle, finite turning radius, a goal pose, and reverse multi-point parking.
velvet_valet.transformation: A self-contained top-down theatre courtyard with procedurally placed parked cars and kerbs, a velvet destination bay, fixed-step visible vehicle kinematics, and two bound input surfaces.
velvet_valet.assets: Procedural HTML/CSS geometry only; no source media copied.
